guidance.goal: Encourage the Jerusalem municipality to approve and keep the bus lane on Aza Street (Azza).
guidance.stance: We support bus lanes in general and want to encourage this one.
guidance.tone: Polite, short, respectful and thankful. Written by a real resident in their own voice. No threats, no insults, no pressure tactics.
guidance.length: One to three short sentences, up to about 250 characters.
guidance.language: Write in the requested language. No commas, periods or line breaks (they are removed anyway).
